'''Reedendu''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed at the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
